description:
Give the shared CLI process fixture the three capabilities migrated tests still reach around it for: committing its repository, spawning an alternate binary, and setting up a linked checkout.

## Background

The shared fixture in `crates/jit/src/test_cli.rs` (`JitCli`) owns a temporary repository, spawns the `jit` binary of the calling integration target with no inherited `JIT_*` variable, and initialises git with a fixed author identity on request. Three groups of tests cannot move onto it, because it lacks:

- **A commit.** It initialises git but cannot stage and commit, so `HEAD` never resolves. `cli_gate/gate_evaluate_all_test.rs` (8 tests) and `cli_gate/gate_evaluate_rerun_test.rs` (2 tests) need a resolved `HEAD`, and so do the failure-probe tests in `cli_issue/command_exit_code_projection_tests.rs` whose probes include `claim renew`.
- **An alternate binary.** `cli_issue/command_exit_code_projection_tests.rs::test_command_exit_codes_serve_foreground_passthrough_is_dual_form` copies the `jit` binary beside a stub `jit-server` and spawns the copy. The fixture only spawns the target binary, so this test builds its own `Command` without the environment scrub.
- **A linked checkout.** `cli_repo_workflow/linked_checkout_write_policy_tests.rs::linked_checkout_fixture` hand-rolls `git init`, its own author identity, `jit init`, a machine-local `.gitignore`, a base commit and `git worktree add`. `divergence_recovery_journey_tests.rs`, `derived_documents_cli_tests.rs` and the failure-probe tests (probe `worktree store-divergence`) depend on that shape.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The fixture stages and commits its repository's working tree under the fixed author identity, so `HEAD` resolves afterwards. The commit ignores the developer's global and system git configuration.
- [hard] REQ-02: The fixture spawns a caller-named program, such as a copy of the `jit` binary, under the same environment as its `jit` commands: working directory at the repository, test mode on, and no inherited `JIT_*` variable.
- [hard] REQ-03: The fixture sets up a primary checkout initialised by `jit init` with one base commit, plus one linked checkout of it. Both checkouts can be addressed as fixtures, and machine-local `.jit/` runtime state is ignored by git in both.
- [hard] REQ-04: Each of the three capabilities has one owning test in `crates/jit/tests/cli_repo_workflow/cli_process_fixture_tests.rs`, and each test passes alone and in parallel with the rest.
- [hard] REQ-05: The fixture adds no integration target, and git runs only through the shared test-support git path that `init_git_repository` already uses.

## Notes

Scope: this task adds the shared capabilities only. Existing hand-rolled copies (`linked_checkout_fixture`, the copied-binary `Command`, per-file commit helpers) are retired by the adoption tasks that depend on it. `dev/TESTING.md` names the new capabilities alongside the fixture's existing ones.
title: The shared CLI fixture commits its repository, spawns an alternate binary and sets up a linked checkout
